description:
`Jido.Codec.decode_json/2` and `decode/2` raise `InternalError "Catalog is not initialized"` for 2-3 s after boot, despite an `{:ok, _} \| {:error, issues}` spec, even with explicit `:catalog`.

Owner: `jido_action.authoring` (`jido.codec`)
Root cause: `lib/jido/codec.ex:80,142`; `lib/jido/catalog/discovery.ex:353`
Claims: flow-runtime.B4, flow-data.D2, flow-runtime.D3
Repro (probe file: id prefix): `10_a_flow_data`: `flow-runtime.B4`
Guides: `guides/flow-data/flow-storage.md:175`; `guides/data/catalog.md:166`

Done when: decode and decode_json return their documented result before Discovery finishes, or the spec and docs state the raise.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B12. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.

comments.text: Fixed in 96e956d for decode. encode still raises; a test pins it and the ticket covers decode.

title: Make Codec decode honour its spec during Discovery boot
